issue: Fixed OAuth2 providers config merge incorrectly replacing the entire slice. Adding an OAuth2 provider removes the client secret of the other already configured providers.
pr_title: Preserve OAuth2 provider client secrets on collection update
pr_body:
OAuth2 client secrets are write-only and are never returned by the API, so the Dashboard submits the providers list without them. Because the whole `providers` slice was replaced on unmarshal, adding a new provider (or editing any provider) wiped the stored client secrets of the already configured providers.

Added `OAuth2Config.UnmarshalJSON` that keeps the stored `clientSecret` for submitted provider configs that don't include one. Explicitly submitted secrets still override the stored ones.

`go test ./apis/ ./core/` passes.
